description: The after screenshot is an empty white page (a failed capture); the commit only edits an invisible meta tag. The model must not list every element as removed; it should return no changes and say the comparison could not be completed.
forbidden_claims: The page's content (header, hero, cards or footer) was removed or deleted in the after version.
required_limitations: The after screenshot is blank or empty, so a visual comparison could not be completed.

limitations: The after screenshot is an empty white page, so the two versions could not be visually compared.
